_README.changelog: v4 (10/10): archetype-row labels in sf06, ku02, ms02, ms06, en01, en04 replaced with real memories (owner-approved); questions unchanged.
_README.built: 2026-10-09 against production (read-only GET probes via scripts/eval-probe.mjs); v3 grown 40 -> 100 on 2026-10-09
_README.format: fixtures[]: id, category, query (owner-voice question), relevantIds (1-5 live memory UUIDs that truly answer it; empty for abstention), mustNotIds (stale/superseded-in-meaning memories that should NOT outrank the answer; optional), notes.
_README.categories: single_fact (16), knowledge_update (18, latest state wins), temporal (14), multi_session (16), entity (16), big_picture (12, themes across many memories), abstention (8, nothing in memory answers it)
_README.verify: node scripts/eval-probe.mjs verify — fetches every relevantId/mustNotId and flags missing/archived/superseded rows
_README.maintenance: Memories are rewritten/archived over time. Re-run verify before trusting a score; replace dead ids rather than deleting the question.
_README.labelling: v3 additions (sf11+, ku09+, tm09+, ms07+, en05+, bp01+, ab05+) were found by browsing the full memory list, several search phrasings and memory links, then each id was read via GET /api/v1/memories/{id}. Machine rows (archetype, cortex, aether, trace, snapshot, delta, advisory) are never labelled in v3; archetypes were only used as a guide for big_picture, and each big_picture item includes memories the archetype does not cite. v2 items are unchanged except that v4 replaced their six archetype-row labels (sf06, ku02, ms02, ms06, en01, en04) with real memories, so no answer label is a machine row.
